High-yield visual plates for Locomotion & Movement (700+ Score Booster)

1. Sarcomere, Actin-Myosin & Cross-Bridge

Z line bisects I band; M line holds thick filaments in H zone; A band stays constant (1.6 µm) during contraction.

2. Neuromuscular Junction (Motor-End Plate) & SR

Motor neuron releases ACh → Sarcolemma action potential → SR releases Ca²⁺ → Binds troponin subunit.

3. Human Skeleton (206): Axial (80 Gold) vs Appendicular (126 Cyan)

Axial = Skull 29 + Vertebral 26 + Sternum 1 + Ribs 24. Appendicular = Girdles 6 + Limbs 120.

4. Synovial Joints Biomechanics

Ball & Socket (Shoulder/Hip), Hinge (Knee/Elbow), Pivot (Atlas-Axis), Saddle (Thumb), Gliding (Carpals).
